items.author: JakeBoyles
items.text:
Rink Life — a first-person rink manager sim that runs in a browser tab.

Resurface the ice. Move the nets. Book the sheet. Fill orders at the concession. Clean up after the last group. Then, if there's time before the next session, take the ice yourself.

Built with Astra and Three.js.

The ice is the part I'd point at. It's a 60×96 grid of wear values sitting behind one canvas texture. Skaters scuff cells as they cross them, the resurfacer clears them behind the blade, and "ice quality" isn't a timer — it's read straight off that grid.

items.summary: Rotate and zoom around a dual-ring energy core modeled in Blender. **Creator:** ruofeng · **Tools / format:** Blender, Three.js, GLB Astra helped build the Blender asset, export GLB materials, create a Three.js viewer an
items.author: oneruofeng
items.text:
用 GPT-6 Astra + Blender + Three.js，把一个 3D 资产从本地模型做到可交互网站并部署上线，整个过程不到半个小时。 
  
流程很短：  
1. 在 Blender 里创建能量核心、双环和金属底座  
2. 导出为 GLB，保留模型和材质结构  
3. 用 Three.js 做网页端实时渲染：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、自动轨道、脉冲与静止模式  
4. 本地用 Vite 跑起来，分别检查桌面端交互  
5. 推送 GitHub，再用 Cloudflare Workers 静态资源部署    

现在 3D 网站从「一个 `.blend` 文件」变成了可直接访问的网页。  
   
在线体验：https://orbital-core-showcase.wangruofeng007.workers.dev
源码：https://github.com/wangruofeng/orbital-core-showcase
   
3D 网站的制作与上线门槛，确实又低了一截。

items.summary: A coded clay scene moves from Astra and Blender into a camera-matched Seedance 2.5 render. **Creator:** Ciri · **Tools / format:** Blender, Seedance 2.5, Animation pipeline Ciri describes Astra coding the geometry in Ble
items.author: Ciri_ai
items.text:
The scene starts as a clay model. Then Seedance 2.5 brings it to life.

Turns out GPT-6 Astra + Dreamina Seedance 2.5 is an actual pipeline. 
Astra codes the geometry → Blender → Clay Renderer Plugin → final render on Dreamina.

The Clay Renderer Plugin keeps the Blender setup intact when moving the clay model into Dreamina. One click gets the scene into Dreamina, with the camera and layout staying locked for the Seedance 2.5 render.

And the full 2.5 quality doesn’t come with a huge premium. My render pass costs less than lunch.

See what you can make with it 👇
#Dreamina #DreaminaPartner

Turns out GPT-6 Astra + Dreamina Seedance 2.5 is an actual pipeline

Astra codes the geometry → Blender → Clay Renderer Plugin → final render on Dreamina.

Hit one click, send the scene over, and Seedance 2.5 takes care of the visual rendering.

items.author: nicekate8888
items.text:
110分钟，Astra建模到剪片全做了

给 GPT 6 Astra medium(fast) 提了一个需求： 用 Blender 做一座「悟空大闹蟠桃园」。🍑

九棵蟠桃树、云海、汉白玉平台、六角亭，还有蹲在树上偷桃的悟空和惊慌的仙女……场景细节都写进了需求里。

然后继续加任务： 给场景设计运镜，做成一分钟视频； 再操作剪映，剪成更吸引人的 30 秒精华版。

从最初提出建模需求，到剪映导出最终成片，前后约 110 分钟。

Astra 做了什么？

🍑 Blender 建模与迭代 搭建场景、角色、材质和灯光，经过 6 轮迭代，保留了 18 张过程图。

🎬 制作运镜视频 设计不同机位的镜头运动，渲染一分钟视频，加入标题，并调用 MiniMax 生成原创配乐。

✂️ 直接操作剪映完成二次剪辑 重新排列镜头、分段变速、添加 6 段趣味字幕，再处理音乐淡出和封面，导出 30 秒成片。

连开头先放悟空偷桃特写，以及「仙女：桃呢？！」这些剪辑安排，也是 Astra 做的😂

我负责提需求、选方向，中途继续追加要求。 

这 110 分钟包含沟通、修改、渲染等待和检查，是这次从需求到成片的实际耗时。

设备：Mac，M4 Max / 128GB 内存 模型：GPT 6 Astra medium(fast)

把这桃园交给悟空，他直接开席。 

把建模和剪辑交给 Astra，你觉得这次
